profile.about:
Most founders post into the void.

I spent 6 years running outbound for two agencies before realizing the founders winning deals weren't cold-calling — they were posting.

PipelineCraft is the system I built from that: 47 founders, $2.1M in attributed pipeline.

DM me 'SYSTEM' if you want the playbook.

experience.title: Founder
experience.description: Built a LinkedIn-led growth system used by 47 B2B founders. $2.1M attributed pipeline in 2025.

posts.text:
Your SDRs aren't the problem. Your founder's invisibility is.

We audited 31 B2B pipelines last quarter. The pattern: companies whose founders post 3x/week sourced 41% of pipeline from LinkedIn. The rest? 6%.

Three things the visible founders do differently:
1. They pick one enemy and attack it weekly
2. They publish proof, not platitudes
3. They end every post with one specific ask

Which one is your founder missing? 👇

How we took a founder from 0 to 14 booked calls in 60 days (without ads):

Week 1-2: rewrote the profile around one ICP.
Week 3-4: published 2 case stories with real numbers.
Week 5-8: daily comment strategy on 20 target accounts.

Result: 14 calls, 5 opportunities, 2 closed at $18k each.

Want the exact checklist? Comment 'CHECKLIST' and I'll DM it.

comments.text: The miss here is treating LinkedIn as a channel instead of a trust engine. We see reply rates double when the founder has posted proof that week.
